details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2199-2249, 2606-2653 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_merge_lease_label_conflict_released` adds `MERGE_LEASE_CONFLICT_RELEASED_LABEL` before the lease release write (`_merge_lease_write` / `_merge_lease_write_holders`), and when that write fails (rc 3 lost_race or rc 1 write_failed) the failure branches log and `continue` / `return 0` without removing the label; per z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, the single-holder path also leaves the hard skip entry `…:released_conflict` (2236-2238).
  WHY: On later ticks the guard `! _merge_lease_has_conflict_released_label` (2200 / 2606-2607) skips the conflict check, so a holder that still conflicts and was never released keeps its slot until TTL or revoke, and its one-time D6 release is used up; the leftover skip entry also blocks re-grant after a head change. All reviewers rated it MAJOR; minimax_minimax-m3 reported it twice, under correctness and under concurrency.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2927-2946 (called at 2205, 2613; grant-loop rechecks at 2330-2331, 2805-2806) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_mt_merge_lease_ready_waiter_exists` checks up to 10 waiters, each through `_merge_lease_pr_eligible` (statuses/required-checks) and `_merge_lease_pr_ready` → `_merge_lease_pr_mergeable` (`GET pulls/<pr>`), with no per-tick cache; it runs once per conflicting holder in multi-holder mode, and the grant loop then reads the same waiters again.
  WHY: This makes about 20 mergeability reads per base per tick in single-holder mode and about 50-60 in multi-holder mode (MERGE_LEASE_MAX_HOLDERS=5), against the issue's limit of "at most 10 per base per tick". The cost repeats every tick while a holder stays conflicted and draws on the shared GitHub rate limit (§14). All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2287-2406, 2710-2880 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A waiter skipped as not ready (`final_ci_pending` / `not_mergeable`) is added to `tick_excluded` / `tm_excluded` but keeps its wait label. `_merge_lease_queue_first` then returns empty, `tick_queue_empty=1` / `tm_queue_empty=1` is set, and the D4 block runs `_merge_lease_unlabel_wait` on skip-held waiters while a labelled waiter is still queued.
  WHY: This causes an unlabel → review dispatch → relabel loop on every tick until the not-ready waiter's final CI finishes or `ready_fallback` fires after `MERGE_LEASE_IDLE_MINUTES` (60 by default), costing a review run and a runner slot each round. Severity disagreement: sonnet, gemini and glm rated it MAJOR and openai_gpt-6-luna rated it NIT; the highest was used.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2384-2393, 2710-2728 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The idle fallback can grant the first not-ready waiter after the 10-candidate scan cap is hit, even when waiters past the cap were never examined.
  WHY: With more than 10 waiters, if the first 10 are not ready and a later one is ready, the scan stops at the cap and the fallback grants a not-ready waiter once the idle threshold is met, without first establishing that no waiter is ready.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:301, 2041; .github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml:430 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new env lines use `${{ vars.REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW || (github.repository == 'shubhodeep1/coding-workflows' && 'ci.yml' || '') }}`, so in the source repo an unset or empty variable falls through to `'ci.yml'`. This gives the cancel_on_pr_close.yml tick a new `gh workflow run` path through `_pr_ensure_final_ci`, gated only by the readiness switches.
  WHY: An operator who sets the variable to empty to disable final-CI dispatch will still see it run. The README documents the default as "empty (off)", but the effective default in the source repo is `ci.yml` (on).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Also add `REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW: ${{ vars.REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW || '' }}` to any tick step among them that lacks it." (issue #10098, scope item 6)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml (tick env lines near 301/304 and 2041) and .github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml (line 430)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The literal expression appears nowhere in the diff, and the delivered lines use `${{ vars.REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW || (github.repository == 'shubhodeep1/coding-workflows' && 'ci.yml' || '') }}`. In the source repository an empty variable therefore does not turn off the final-CI gate or dispatch, and cancel_on_pr_close.yml gains a default `ci.yml`. The deviation is documented in agents.d/merge-lease-short-cs-p1-ready-grant.md, which mirrors the existing poller convention (orchestrate_poll.yml:1564, 1831). `test_poll_and_close_ticks_set_the_final_ci_workflow` (tests/test_merge_lease_ready_grant.py:342-347) only checks that the line exists. Reviewers disagreed on severity: NIT from sonnet, luna and glm; MAJOR from gemini and minimax.
- requirement: "Wire it into .github/workflows/ci.yml (`tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py` enforces this)." (issue #10098)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/ci.yml
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: `tests/test_merge_lease_ready_grant.py` is not referenced explicitly in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash said this is not a gap, because the `tests-system-python` catch-all (ci.yml:4411; tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py:40-50 / 115-160) collects every tests/test_*.py file and ci.yml is outside files_touched.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:_mt_merge_lease_tick, lines 2287-2292 (`[ -n "${tick_first}" ] || tick_queue_empty=1`), 2351-2354 (a not-ready waiter is added to `tick_excluded` but keeps its label), 2396-2405 (the D4 block that unlabels every PR in `tick_skip_held_prs`). The same pattern is in _mt_merge_lease_tick_multi at 2711-2712 (`tm_queue_empty=1`), 2733 (`tm_excluded`) and 2874 (the D4 block). | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When a not-ready waiter is excluded, the queue reads as empty and D4 unlabels skip-held waiters while that labelled waiter is still queued.
  WHY: A skip-held waiter is unlabelled, re-dispatched and relabelled every tick until B's final CI finishes or MERGE_LEASE_IDLE_MINUTES (60) passes; each round costs a review dispatch and a runner slot. Suggested fix: skip D4 while `tick_fb_pr` / `tm_fb_pr` is non-empty.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:_mt_merge_lease_tick, lines 2204-2207 (`_merge_lease_label_conflict_released "${MERGE_LEASE_PR}"` runs before `tick_reason="released_conflict"`) and 2243-2248 (when `_merge_lease_write` fails, the tick logs `lost_race` / `write_failed` and runs `continue` without removing the label). _mt_merge_lease_tick_multi has the same pattern: the label POST in the step-5 block before line 2620, then the failure branch at 2647-2652 (`return 0`). | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The conflict-released label is written before the CAS lease write, and a failed write leaves the label on a holder that was not released.
  WHY: The guard at line 2200 skips the conflict check on later ticks, so a still-conflicting holder keeps the lease until TTL or revoke. Suggested fix: DELETE the label in both failure branches when the reason is `released_conflict`.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:_mt_merge_lease_ready_waiter_exists (hunk at about 2924-2946), called from line 2205 and from the multi-holder step-5 block just before 2620 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The scan of up to 10 waiters makes about 3 calls each (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3875-3876, `_merge_lease_pr_mergeable`), is never cached, repeats every tick, and the grant loop reads the same waiters again.
  WHY: This makes about 20 reads per base on a single-holder release tick and 50 or more in multi-holder mode, against the issue's limit of 10, on the shared rate limit (§14). Suggested fix: cache the result per base per tick (`tick_rwe_result` / `tm_rwe_result`).
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Also add `REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW: ${{ vars.REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW || '' }}` to any tick step among them that lacks it." (issue #10098, scope item 6)
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml (the env lines added near 304 and 2041) and .github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml (the env line added near 430).
  Evidence of absence: The lines use the repo-conditional `'ci.yml'` fallback instead. The deviation is documented in agents.d/merge-lease-short-cs-p1-ready-grant.md but was not approved by the issue, and the test only checks that the line exists.
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
- Note: the ci.yml wiring is not a gap, because the `tests-system-python` catch-all at .github/workflows/ci.yml:4411 collects the file (tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py:40-50).
- HARDENING (2 related items): (1) scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_merge_lease_label_conflict_released` does not check the shape of `lcr_repo`, so an empty value builds `repos//issues/<n>/labels`; suggested fix is a 1-line regex check. (2) scripts/review_merge_train.sh line 2387 / `tm_fb_since` line 2718: a legacy record with no `updated=` reads as 0, so `ready_fallback` fires on the first tick; suggested fix is to require `MERGE_LEASE_UPDATED` > 0 (2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:_mt_merge_lease_tick (lines 2334-2354) and _mt_merge_lease_tick_multi (lines 2805-2821) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A not-ready waiter is excluded but keeps its label, so the queue reads as empty and `_merge_lease_unlabel_wait` runs on a skip-held waiter.
  WHY: This causes an unlabel/re-dispatch/re-label loop on every tick until the final CI completes or the idle fallback fires (60 min), wasting review dispatches and runner slots.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:_mt_merge_lease_tick (lines 2199-2208) and _mt_merge_lease_tick_multi (lines 2612-2615) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The conflict-release label is POSTed before the lease write, and a failed write (rc=3 or write_failed) leaves the PR held while carrying the label.
  WHY: Later ticks treat the PR as already released, so a conflicting holder keeps its slot.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:_mt_merge_lease_ready_waiter_exists (lines 2927-2942) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The function makes several uncached API calls for up to 10 waiters, for each conflict-released holder, on every tick.
  WHY: This wastes GitHub API calls and risks the rate limit, repeating for every holder and on later ticks.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Wire it into .github/workflows/ci.yml (`tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py` enforces this)." (issue #10098)
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/ci.yml
  Evidence of absence: `tests/test_merge_lease_ready_grant.py` is not referenced explicitly in ci.yml, and the plan requires explicit wiring.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3

  Requirement: "Also add `REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW: ${{ vars.REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW || '' }}` to any tick step among them that lacks it." (issue #10098, scope item 6)
